req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs. This is a critical feature for API observability, allowing developers to explore and understand the API endpoints. The test suite will include a positive test to ensure the Swagger UI is served correctly, a negative test to handle unexpected paths, and a boundary test to check the response for a valid but minimal request.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_served
preconditions: The FastAPI application is running and configured correctly.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint.
expected: The response status code should be 200.
The response content should include Swagger UI HTML.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert '<title>Swagger UI</title>' in response.text

tests.name: test_invalid_path
actions: Send a GET request to an invalid endpoint /invalid.
expected: The response status code should be 404.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/invalid')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_boundary
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint with minimal headers.
expected: The response status code should be 200.
The response content should include Swagger UI HTML.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs', headers={})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert '<title>Swagger UI</title>' in response.text
